items.headline: Lawrence McCutcheon, 5-time Pro Bowl RB for Rams, dies at 76
items.body: Lawrence McCutcheon, a five-time Pro Bowl running back for the Los Angeles Rams who went on to a long career in the team's front office, died Friday. He was 76.

items.headline: Seahawks rule out RB Zach Charbonnet vs. Chiefs

items.headline: Giants LB Tremaine Edmunds (chest) out for year, source says
items.body: Giants linebacker Tremaine Edmunds will miss the rest of the season with a torn chest muscle, a source told ESPN's Jordan Raanan. Edmunds leads the team with 50 tackles and wears the green dot to make the calls on defense.

items.body: Bears tight end Cole Kmet will miss the remainder of the 2026 season after he suffered a serious right knee injury during Chicago's 30-24 win over New England.

items.headline: Falcons' viral stripes will appear down center of helmets
items.body: A vertical stripe pattern that the Falcons used in a social media post will appear down the middle of the team's throwback helmets. The stripes drew significant online backlash as some saw similarity to Nazi Germany imagery.

items.headline: Cam Skattebo set to return to Giants RB mix after being 'taught a lesson'
items.body: After zero carries in Week 6, Cam Skattebo says he took a step back to evaluate and correct, and Giants' coach says he should return to the running back mix vs. the Texans.

items.body: Rams wide receiver Puka Nacua (calf) will not practice Friday and is questionable to play Sunday against the Raiders, coach Sean McVay said.

items.body: NFL commissioner Roger Goodell reiterated his goal to hold a regular-season game in Tokyo and said he thinks it could happen in 2027 or 2028.
